name: Nagging
overview: Scripture warns against the destructive nature of nagging and contentious behavior, particularly within marriage. Proverbs repeatedly compares a nagging or brawling woman to continual dripping or relentless rain, highlighting the wearisome and divisive effect on the household (Proverbs 19:13; 27:15). The wisdom literature also emphasizes that it is better to live in isolation or harsh conditions than to endure constant strife caused by a contentious spouse, whether husband or wife (Proverbs 21:9, 21:19, 25:24). Furthermore, nagging and contention are likened to fire that kindles strife, underscoring the danger such attitudes pose to peace and unity (Proverbs 26:21).
